fullText.simplified:
第33章、没有结束

    高静死了，昨天晚上就死了，但是李河一点儿都不知道。
    这不是李河想要的结果。虽然高静杀了人，但是他一点儿都不想高静这样死去。她为什么要死？她的死和他有关系吗？
    李河难过极了，不能好好工作了。他请了一个月假，去很远的北方旅行。
    那儿很美，虽然还只是十月，但是已经开始下雪了。他在下着大雪的城市里住了一个月。有一天，太阳出来了，他一下子有了力气。第二天，他回来了。
    同事们看到他，都很高兴，他也很高兴。他坐在桌子前面，拉开抽屉，里面还有春草写给他的信，他再看了一遍。
    “警察永远抓不到我书里的坏人”——那时候的春草这样说，不，是高静这样说。
    李河笑了笑，不管什么时候，李河都相信，警察一定能抓到坏人。
    他把信放下，然后打开电脑，开始工作。
    虽然高静的事情已经过去了，但李河知道他的工作还没有结束。李河要找到张一南，只有找到张一南，听张一南说一说他和高静的事，李河才能和这几个月的自己说再见。
他去了高静的中学，问了她以前的老师和同学，还去了张一南的家，但还是没有人知道张一南去了哪儿。李河还去了一些其他的城市，他请那些城市的警察也帮忙找张一南，但都没有发现。
    李河觉得很奇怪，越是找不到张一南，他就越是想找到张一南。李河知道，这中间一定有问题，只有找到张一南，才能知道问题是什么。
    时间过得很快，三年过去了。李河还没有找到张一南。
fullText.traditional:
第33章、沒有結束

    高靜死了，昨天晚上就死了，但是李河一點兒都不知道。
    這不是李河想要的結果。雖然高靜殺了人，但是他一點兒都不想高靜這樣死去。她為什麼要死？她的死和他有關係嗎？
    李河難過極了，不能好好工作了。他請了一個月假，去很遠的北方旅行。
    那兒很美，雖然還只是十月，但是已經開始下雪了。他在下著大雪的城市裡住了一個月。有一天，太陽出來了，他一下子有了力氣。第二天，他回來了。
    同事們看到他，都很高興，他也很高興。他坐在桌子前面，拉開抽屜，裡面還有春草寫給他的信，他再看了一遍。
    “警察永遠抓不到我書裡的壞人”——那時候的春草這樣說，不，是高靜這樣說。
    李河笑了笑，不管什麼時候，李河都相信，警察一定能抓到壞人。
    他把信放下，然後打開電腦，開始工作。
    雖然高靜的事情已經過去了，但李河知道他的工作還沒有結束。李河要找到張一南，只有找到張一南，聽張一南說一說他和高靜的事，李河才能和這幾個月的自己說再見。
他去了高靜的中學，問了她以前的老師和同學，還去了張一南的家，但還是沒有人知道張一南去了哪兒。李河還去了一些其他的城市，他請那些城市的警察也幫忙找張一南，但都沒有發現。
    李河覺得很奇怪，越是找不到張一南，他就越是想找到張一南。李河知道，這中間一定有問題，只有找到張一南，才能知道問題是什麼。
    時間過得很快，三年過去了。李河還沒有找到張一南。

sentences.pinyin: gāo jìng sǐ le zuó tiān wǎn shang jiù sǐ le dàn shì lǐ hé yì diǎn'r dōu bù zhī dào
sentences.english: Gao Jing was dead. She died last night, but Li He had no idea.

sentences.simplified: 这不是李河想要的结果。虽然高静杀了人，但是他一点儿都不想高静这样死去。
sentences.traditional: 這不是李河想要的結果。雖然高靜殺了人，但是他一點兒都不想高靜這樣死去。
sentences.pinyin: zhè bú shì lǐ hé xiǎng yào de jié guǒ suī rán gāo jìng shā le rén dàn shì tā yì diǎn'r dōu bù xiǎng gāo jìng zhè yàng sǐ qù
sentences.english: This wasn’t the ending that Li He wanted. Although Gao Jing had killed someone, he really didn’t want her to die like this.

sentences.simplified: 她为什么要死？她的死和他有关系吗？
sentences.traditional: 她為什麼要死？她的死和他有關係嗎？
sentences.pinyin: tā wèi shén me yào sǐ tā de sǐ hé tā yǒu guān xi ma
sentences.english: Why did she have to die? Was her death related to him?

sentences.simplified: 李河难过极了，不能好好工作了。他请了一个月假，去很远的北方旅行。
sentences.traditional: 李河難過極了，不能好好工作了。他請了一個月假，去很遠的北方旅行。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ hé nán guò jí le bù néng hǎo hǎo gōng zuò le tā qǐng le yí ge yuè jià qù hěn yuǎn de běi fāng lǚ xíng
sentences.english: Li He was very sad and unable to work properly. He took one month of leave and went on a holiday in the far north.

sentences.simplified: 那儿很美，虽然还只是十月，但是已经开始下雪了。
sentences.traditional: 那兒很美，雖然還只是十月，但是已經開始下雪了。
sentences.pinyin: nà'r hěn měi suī rán hái zhǐ shì shí yuè dàn shì yǐ jīng kāi shǐ xià xuě le
sentences.english: It was beautiful there. Even though it was only October, it had already started snowing.

sentences.simplified: 他在下着大雪的城市里住了一个月。
sentences.traditional: 他在下著大雪的城市裡住了一個月。
sentences.pinyin: tā zài xià zhe dà xuě de chéng shì lǐ zhù le yí ge yuè
sentences.english: He lived in the snowy city for one month.

sentences.simplified: 有一天，太阳出来了，他一下子有了力气。第二天，他回来了。
sentences.traditional: 有一天，太陽出來了，他一下子有了力氣。第二天，他回來了。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yì tiān tài yáng chū lái le tā yí xià zi yǒu le lì qi dì èr tiān tā huí lái le
sentences.english: One day, the sun came out. All of a sudden, he felt energetic. The next day, he returned.

sentences.simplified: 同事们看到他，都很高兴，他也很高兴。
sentences.traditional: 同事們看到他，都很高興，他也很高興。
sentences.pinyin: tóng shì men kàn dào tā dōu hěn gāo xìng tā yě hěn gāo xìng
sentences.english: When his colleagues saw him, they were all very happy. He was also very happy.

sentences.simplified: 他坐在桌子前面，拉开抽屉，里面还有春草写给他的信，他再看了一遍。
sentences.traditional: 他坐在桌子前面，拉開抽屜，裡面還有春草寫給他的信，他再看了一遍。
sentences.pinyin: tā zuò zài zhuō zi qián miàn lā kāi chōu ti lǐ miàn hái yǒu chūn cǎo xiě gěi tā de xìn tā zài kàn le yí biàn
sentences.english: He sat in front of his desk and opened the drawer. The letters Chun Cao had written him were still inside. He read them over again.

sentences.simplified: “警察永远抓不到我书里的坏人”——那时候的春草这样说，不，是高静这样说。
sentences.traditional: “警察永遠抓不到我書裡的壞人”——那時候的春草這樣說，不，是高靜這樣說。
sentences.pinyin: jǐng chá yǒng yuǎn zhuā bú dào wǒ shū lǐ de huài rén nà shí hou de chūn cǎo zhè yàng shuō bù shì gāo jìng zhè yàng shuō
sentences.english: “The police can never catch the bad guys in my books”— that’s what Chun Cao had said at that time. No, it’s what Gao Jing had said.

sentences.simplified: 李河笑了笑，不管什么时候，李河都相信，警察一定能抓到坏人。
sentences.traditional: 李河笑了笑，不管什麼時候，李河都相信，警察一定能抓到壞人。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ hé xiào le xiào bù guǎn shén me shí hou lǐ hé dōu xiāng xìn jǐng chá yí dìng néng zhuā dào huài rén
sentences.english: Li He smiled. No matter what, Li He still believed that police will always be able to catch the bad guys.

sentences.simplified: 他把信放下，然后打开电脑，开始工作。
sentences.traditional: 他把信放下，然後打開電腦，開始工作。
sentences.pinyin: tā bǎ xìn fàng xià rán hòu dǎ kāi diàn nǎo kāi shǐ gōng zuò
sentences.english: He put down the letter, then turned on the computer and started to work.

sentences.simplified: 虽然高静的事情已经过去了，但李河知道他的工作还没有结束。
sentences.traditional: 雖然高靜的事情已經過去了，但李河知道他的工作還沒有結束。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán gāo jìng de shì qing yǐ jīng guò qù le dàn lǐ hé zhī dào tā de gōng zuò hái méi yǒu jié shù
sentences.english: Although Gao Jing’s case was already in the past, Li He knew that his work still hadn’t finished.

sentences.simplified: 李河要找到张一南，只有找到张一南，听张一南说一说他和高静的事，
sentences.traditional: 李河要找到張一南，只有找到張一南，聽張一南說一說他和高靜的事，
sentences.pinyin: lǐ hé yào zhǎo dào zhāng yī nán zhǐ yǒu zhǎo dào zhāng yī nán tīng zhāng yī nán shuō yì shuō tā hé gāo jìng de shì
sentences.english: Li He needed to find Zhang Yinan because only by finding Zhang Yinan and hearing Zhang Yinan talk about his relationship with Gao Jing ..

sentences.simplified: 李河才能和这几个月的自己说再见。
sentences.traditional: 李河才能和這幾個月的自己說再見。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ hé cái néng hé zhè jǐ ge yuè de zì jǐ shuō zài jiàn
sentences.english: .. could Li He say goodbye to what had happened to him in the past few months.

sentences.simplified: 他去了高静的中学，问了她以前的老师和同学，
sentences.traditional: 他去了高靜的中學，問了她以前的老師和同學，
sentences.pinyin: tā qù le gāo jìng de zhōng xué wèn le tā yǐ qián de lǎo shī hé tóng xué
sentences.english: He went to Gao Jing’s high school and asked her old teachers and classmates.

sentences.simplified: 还去了张一南的家，但还是没有人知道张一南去了哪儿。
sentences.traditional: 還去了張一南的家，但還是沒有人知道張一南去了哪兒。
sentences.pinyin: hái qù le zhāng yī nán de jiā dàn hái shi méi yǒu rén zhī dào zhāng yī nán qù le nǎ'r
sentences.english: He even went to Zhang Yinan’s house, but nobody knew where Zhang Yinan had gone.

sentences.simplified: 李河还去了一些其他的城市，他请那些城市的警察也帮忙找张一南，但都没有发现。
sentences.traditional: 李河還去了一些其他的城市，他請那些城市的警察也幫忙找張一南，但都沒有發現。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ hé hái qù le yì xiē qí tā de chéng shì tā qǐng nà xiē chéng shì de jǐng chá yě bāng máng zhǎo zhāng yī nán dàn dōu méi yǒu fā xiàn
sentences.english: Li He even went to a few other cities. He asked the police in these cities to help find Zhang Yinan, but they couldn’t find him.

sentences.simplified: 李河觉得很奇怪，越是找不到张一南，他就越是想找到张一南。
sentences.traditional: 李河覺得很奇怪，越是找不到張一南，他就越是想找到張一南。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ hé jué de hěn qí guài yuè shì zhǎo bú dào zhāng yī nán tā jiù yuè shì xiǎng zhǎo dào zhāng yī nán
sentences.english: Li He thought it was very odd. The more he couldn’t find Zhang Yinan, the more he wanted to find Zhang Yinan.

sentences.simplified: 李河知道，这中间一定有问题，只有找到张一南，才能知道问题是什么。
sentences.traditional: 李河知道，這中間一定有問題，只有找到張一南，才能知道問題是什麼。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ hé zhī dào zhè zhōng jiān yí dìng yǒu wèn tí zhǐ yǒu zhǎo dào zhāng yī nán cái néng zhī dào wèn tí shì shén me
sentences.english: Li He knew that there must be a problem somewhere. He could only find out what the problem was if he found Zhang Yinan.

sentences.simplified: 时间过得很快，三年过去了。李河还没有找到张一南。
sentences.traditional: 時間過得很快，三年過去了。李河還沒有找到張一南。
sentences.pinyin: shí jiān guò de hěn kuài sān nián guò qù le lǐ hé hái méi yǒu zhǎo dào zhāng yī nán
sentences.english: Time flew by. Three years had passed. Li He still hadn’t found Zhang Yinan.

sentence_translations: Chapter 33: No Ending
Gao Jing was dead. She died last night, but Li He had no idea.
This wasn’t the ending that Li He wanted. Although Gao Jing had killed someone, he really didn’t want her to die like this.
Why did she have to die? Was her death related to him?
Li He was very sad and unable to work properly. He took one month of leave and went on a holiday in the far north.
It was beautiful there. Even though it was only October, it had already started snowing.
He lived in the snowy city for one month.
One day, the sun came out. All of a sudden, he felt energetic. The next day, he returned.
When his colleagues saw him, they were all very happy. He was also very happy.
He sat in front of his desk and opened the drawer. The letters Chun Cao had written him were still inside. He read them over again.
“The police can never catch the bad guys in my books”— that’s what Chun Cao had said at that time. No, it’s what Gao Jing had said.
Li He smiled. No matter what, Li He still believed that police will always be able to catch the bad guys.
He put down the letter, then turned on the computer and started to work.
Although Gao Jing’s case was already in the past, Li He knew that his work still hadn’t finished.
Li He needed to find Zhang Yinan because only by finding Zhang Yinan and hearing Zhang Yinan talk about his relationship with Gao Jing ..
.. could Li He say goodbye to what had happened to him in the past few months.
He went to Gao Jing’s high school and asked her old teachers and classmates.
He even went to Zhang Yinan’s house, but nobody knew where Zhang Yinan had gone.
Li He even went to a few other cities. He asked the police in these cities to help find Zhang Yinan, but they couldn’t find him.
Li He thought it was very odd. The more he couldn’t find Zhang Yinan, the more he wanted to find Zhang Yinan.
Li He knew that there must be a problem somewhere. He could only find out what the problem was if he found Zhang Yinan.
Time flew by. Three years had passed. Li He still hadn’t found Zhang Yinan.
